name: Theon of Alexandria
bio: Theon of Alexandria is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 5th century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 292).

poems.title: Book VII, 292
poems.author: Theon of Alexandria
poems.text: The halcyons, perchance, care for thee, Lenaeus, but thy mother mourns for thee dumbly over thy cold tomb.
